title: Russian — GOST 7.79-2000 System B (ASCII)
description: ASCII variant of GOST 7.79-2000 (System B, digraphs instead of diacritics), used e.g. in Russian bibliographic and electronic data: Х→X, Ц→C/CZ, Щ→SHH, Ъ→``, Ы→Y`, Ь→`, Э→E`.
notes: The standard recommends c 'before i, e, y, j' (Latin letters). Following iuliia, this scheme applies c before Е, И, Ы, Й (and pre-1918 І); a literal reading of the Latin letters would also give c before Э (e`), Ё (yo), Ю (yu), Я (ya).
Pre-1918 letters: І→i (i' before consonants), Ѣ→ye, Ѳ→fh, Ѵ→yh.
Ъ is two grave accents (``), Ь one grave accent (`), both U+0060.

rules.note: recommended c before i, e, y, j; cz elsewhere

samples: Юлия, съешь ещё этих мягких французских булок из Йошкар-Олы, да выпей алтайского чаю
